# `bs delete`

- **Usage:** `bs delete [--dry-run] <ID>…`

Delete bits permanently without prompting; preview first with --dry-run

## Arguments
- **`<ID>…`** — One or more exact SHELF/NAME identifiers

## Flags
- **`--dry-run`** — Preview without changing files
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
